class.name: armctl_ros2_control/SingularityController
class.description: Singularity-robust velocity controller (armctl, Phase 5) exposed as a ros2_control plugin. Runs the through-singularity reference against whichever of naive / fixed-lambda DLS / adaptive-lambda DLS is selected by the `controller_law` parameter, against real dynamics (Webots or hardware) instead of the kinematic offline integrator.
